biography: Carlton Brown's journey began not on a racetrack, but on the windswept moors of Yorkshire, where his father ran a small garage. From the age of eight, Carlton was dismantling and reassembling engines, a fascination that quickly morphed into a burning desire to race. His first taste of competitive motorsport came in karting, where his aggressive, no-holds-barred style quickly earned him both wins and a reputation. Funding his early racing through odd jobs and the occasional poker game, Carlton eventually secured a seat in the Caterham Superlight series, a proving ground for aspiring racers. While his early career was marked by flashes of brilliance interspersed with costly errors, he's matured into a consistent front-runner, a force to be reckoned with on any circuit. He aims to break into single-seater racing and dreams of one day competing at Le Mans, but for now, he is considered at his peak within the Caterham series.
drivingStyle: Carlton's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression.' He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and his ability to extract every last ounce of grip from his tires. While he can be prone to overdriving the car, especially in the early stages of a race, he possesses an uncanny ability to adapt to changing track conditions. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, but he compensates with an unwavering commitment to pushing the limits, often finding speed where others see only risk. He thrives under pressure, seemingly relishing wheel-to-wheel combat.

rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor in the Caterham series, Carlton and Isabelle have a long-standing rivalry dating back to a controversial collision that cost Isabelle the championship in 2020.
Marcus is the antithesis of Carlton - calculating and clinical. Their opposing styles often clash, with Marcus frequently criticizing Carlton's overly aggressive tactics.

Kenji and Carlton have had a few close calls and near-misses on the track. There is mutual respect, but both drivers know that whoever gives an inch will pay the price. Expect fireworks when they are on the same track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, even if they are threadbare.
Listens to classical music precisely 30 minutes before every race to calm his nerves.
He polishes his helmet visor with a specific brand of microfiber cloth and a special solution he mixes himself.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about finesse; it's about having the guts to push harder when everyone else backs down."
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham Superlight Championship at Brands Hatch in 2022, after a season-long battle with Isabelle Rossi, securing the title on the final lap with a daring overtake.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Silverstone in 2019 due to a mechanical failure, costing him valuable championship points and a potential victory.
